Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring agencies to provide truthful information to legislators.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring agencies to provide truthfulinformation to legislators; and adding a new section to chapter 44.16RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 44.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) All agency employees must answer completely and honestly anyrequest of the legislature in furtherance of a legislativeinvestigative or oversight purpose. (2) As used in this section, "agency" has the meaning in RCW34.05.010.
